`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` matches the ruled shape line by line: `repository_dispatch` `types: [fleet-write]` only; `run-name` carries the request id; `permissions: {}` at workflow level; payload reaches the scripts through `env:`, never interpolated into a `run:` line; mint via `actions/create-github-app-token@v2` with `owner`, `repositories: <validator output>`, `permission-issues: write`, `permission-pull-requests: write`, `permission-metadata: read`; the executor gets the token through `env:` only; `persist-credentials: false`. `lint.yml` gains the three self-test steps. CI on `690954b7` is red on `Lint & Repo Gates` because the three `check:pm-fleet-write-*` rows exist only on PR B — the declared A→B dependency, by design. Open question 1 (job-level `contents: read`): **A**, keep it — read-only, the write path stays the App token; the deviation is recorded. Landing: after PR B is on `main`, this branch takes `origin/main` (update-branch), CI goes green, then the maintainer merges by hand (`.github/workflows/**`).

## PR #19725 (PR B, scripts) — content PASS, one patch round before landing

What passes: 12 files, all inside the claimed surface plus the two roster-forced touches (`write-pace.mjs` roster respelled repo-relative and the matching literal in `fleet-token.mjs`) — mechanical, same gate family, explained in the body: accepted under the four conditions. `ops.mjs` is the single spelling of the closed op list, caps and permissions; every request the table can emit is an issue/PR write or one of the four GraphQL mutations — no merge, review, ref, contents, workflow, release or org endpoint. `validate.mjs` refuses unknown envelope and per-action keys, non-integers, over-cap strings, targets outside `objectstack-ai`, malformed sessions, and pins the platform's `client_payload` ceilings. `execute.mjs`: sender gate on `collaborators/{login}/permission` (write / maintain / admin), stop at the first failure, summary table, token scrubbed. `dispatch.mjs`: one paced dispatch per stroke, run found by name, UNCONFIRMED exit 6, never auto-retried. `skip-changeset` matches (root `package.json` and `scripts/pm/**` ship nowhere). CI on `b656a699`: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `mergeable_state: clean`. `api_writes` 12 / `mcp_calls` 0, within budget. Open question 2 (`contents: write` for auto-merge): **A**, keep the narrow mint, the live probe decides, a one-line fix in PR A if refused. Open question 3 (ceilings): **A**, tune from the probe.

**The one item — a rollout hazard the card under-specified, ⛔ not the dev's error.** `selectTransport` under `auto` returns `dispatch` for every cloud seat container (`CCR_AGENT_PROXY_ENABLED=1` is set in all of them), and `resolveRoute` then refuses with exit 3 when `OS_FLEET_SESSION` is absent (dispatch.mjs :37–:43, :333). Every running seat today has no `OS_FLEET_SESSION`. So the moment this PR is on `main`, every `label-write` / `post-stamped` / `issue-create` / `close-cards` write in every cloud seat fails until each seat exports the variable; and once they do, before PR A + the org variable + the App installation are live, every write waits the 90 s start window before falling back. A default that breaks or slows a seat that has not opted in cannot land.

**Ruled patch (same claim, same dev, one commit on `claude/issue-19701-fleet-write-transport`):**
1. `auto` selects `dispatch` only when ALL three hold: the cloud discriminator; a well-formed `OS_FLEET_SESSION`; and the relay is live on the board — ONE cached read per process, `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/contents/.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml?ref=main` → 200 (404 ⇒ not live; any other status ⇒ not live, said so). Any condition failing ⇒ `direct`, with ONE printed line naming which condition failed. ⛔ No 90 s wait in that path.
2. Explicit `OS_FLEET_TRANSPORT=dispatch` stays strict: missing session or relay not live ⇒ exit 3, as now.
3. The 90 s / 5 min ceilings and the no-run fallback stay as the second net for a relay that is live but silent.
4. Self-tests pin the three-condition selector (each condition alone failing ⇒ `direct` + its line; all three ⇒ `dispatch`; explicit `dispatch` ⇒ strict); every existing self-test stays green; the PR body's transport section is updated. ⛔ Nothing else changes.

After that commit: this seat re-reads, then lands PR B through the queue (not a governed surface), then PR A takes `origin/main` and waits for the maintainer's hand. Live probe (director, after the maintainer's org variable and App installation): one `comment` on this card via `post-stamped` under `auto` with `OS_FLEET_SESSION` set, read back `user.login == objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
